management.mgmt-ports: 1x RJ-45 console, 1x RJ-45 100/1000BASE-T, 1x USB-A storage (all front)

performance.packet-buffer: 16 MB on-chip plus 6 GB deep DRAM buffer

power.psus: 2x redundant, load-sharing, hot-swappable AC or -48 VDC

gaps.wanted: the buried marks moved clear of the components that paint over them

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor
`physical-context` on 8 bays (rear 8); `physical-context` on port groups qsfp28, sfp-plus - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
the Nautobot exporter is not importable - unlocks NetBox / Nautobot device-type export

provenance.bottom-row-labels: 51 and 54 are NOT silkscreened on the unit; drawn dimmed for reference only
provenance.chassis: datasheet (Dimensions WxDxH 440 x 548 x 44 mm; Weight 9.34 kg). Note this chassis is NOT the 438.4 x 43.5 of the AS7726/AS7326 line - it is 440 x 44
provenance.mgmt-leds: LNK and ACT, bracketed to the management port between the Mgmt and Console silkscreen lines (IMG_2179)
provenance.mgmt-silkscreen: an up-arrow Mgmt line over a down-arrow Console line, beneath the RJ45 stack
provenance.port-arrangement: datasheet Interfaces figure - 48 SFP+ as 2 rows x 24 columns in three visual groups of 8, and 6 QSFP28 as 2 columns x 3 rows
provenance.port-numbering: read off the unit's silkscreen in the 3D capture. SFP+ pairs read N-up / N+1-down (45 up, 46 down, 47 up, 48 down), so column-major. QSFP is also column-major but NOT contiguous with a row reading - the strip below QSFP row 2 reads '49 up / 50 down' and '52 up / 53 down', which puts the unlabelled bottom row at 51 and 54, not 53 and 54
provenance.port-pitch: standard - SFP columns on the SFF-8433 basic 14.25, QSFP on the 19.0 measured from TE 2322551-4. Feasibility checks out - 24 x 14.25 = 342 plus 2 x 19.0 = 38 plus the management stack fits the 440mm panel
provenance.qsfp-geometry: QSFP row 2 shares its bottom edge with the SFP+ bottom row; the 12.0 and 14.5 row spacings are preserved from the datasheet figure
provenance.qsfp-leds: between the belly-to-belly pair, per column - up arrow, two round LEDs, down arrow (capture frame 0)
provenance.rear-layout: datasheet figure (PSU each end, six fans between, numbered 6..1)
provenance.rj45-orientation: the pair is mirrored with the latch keyways facing AWAY from each other, so the upper jack is the inverted one (IMG_2179)
provenance.top-bottom-sides: from the unit. Bottom label placement, the side-rail vent slots and the rear-corner access panel are from IMG_2178; the top grooves and side venting from the Object Capture frames. Positions are photo-inferred, not measured - the chassis outline is the datasheet's 440 x 548 x 44
provenance.usb-area: the honeycomb stops either side of the USB port - that patch of panel is flat - and the USB trident is printed to its right (owner, from the unit)
